record_audits.database_subject: Antimicrobial Property and Mode of Action of the Skin Peptides of the Sado Wrinkled Frog, Glandirana susurra, against Animal and Plant Pathogens.
record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (72.5%) to Rugosin B. Mol Wt: 4414.154; Mol formula: C199H323N50O56S2; Mol ex coeff.: 7102.5; GRAVY: -0.47; L: 10%; A: 7%; S: 12%; N: 7%, K: 17%, one unpaired Cys. Activity: Active against E. coli, S. enterica, and P. aeruginosa and the fungus C. albicans (MIC 30 uM) but inactive against S.aureus. Brevinin-2SSb also possessed significant activities and, at concentrations of 4, 16, and 128 ug/mL, completely inhibited the growth of the plant pathogens: Gram-negative bacterium X. oryzae pv. oryzae, which causes a serious blight of rice; the Gram-positive bacterium C. michiganensis subsp. michiganensis, which causes ring-rot disease in potatoes; and the fungus P. oryzae (synonym M. oryzae), which causes rice blast disease. Antioxidative activities of brevinin-2SS were evaluated using a standard 2,20-azinobis-(3-ethylbenzothiazoline-6-sulfonate) (ABTS) method. The peptide showed a strong free-radical scavenging activity in a dose-depedent manner (20 ug/ml at 82.3%), due to the presence of a free Cys. The peptide is toxic to mammalian cells (32 ug/ml, survival rates of COS7, HepG2, and CPAE (11.5, 4.7, and 0.8%). Peptide sequence kindly provided by Prof. Iwamuro.

source_review_notes: Peptide identities were traced to Supplementary Figure S1 and synthetic peptide methods.
Exact cytotoxicity rows for Brevinin-2SSb and Ranatuerin-2SSa at 32 ug/mL are source-supported by text survival rates and reconciled to database killing values.
Exact graph-derived antimicrobial percentages and some MIC-like database calls are preserved as source_conflict when not text-tabulated in local primary materials.
DRAMP activity rows in this packet contain only source IDs and therefore remain database_only_no_primary_source rather than fabricated assay rows.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local primary source provides prose summaries and concentration-response figures, but no primary-source table of exact per-point antimicrobial values or MIC calls for every database row.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Source-supported qualitative/prose activity rows are retained; exact database-only inhibition or MIC annotations without tabulated primary support are preserved as source_conflict instead of promoted to source_verified.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The primary text gives exact 32 ug/mL survival values for COS7 and HepG2 for granuliberin-SSa and describes CPAE as dose-dependent, but it does not tabulate the exact CPAE 32 ug/mL value carried by database rows.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Granuliberin-SSa CPAE toxicity is retained as a source-located dose-dependent activity row, while the exact linked database percentage remains source_conflict.
